author: BmB
body:
Ok is a DTM tiebreaker really needed, unless it is inovative and different to normal DTC it will be boring. 

Wouldnt it be simpler, more varied and more fun to have a TDM as a tiebreaker? I think this could be a lot better for the tournament than most of the current Tiebreaker ideas.

title: TDM Tiebreaker

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Okay, it was considered, and I am here to crash the party;

A team deathmatch really isn't the deathmatch you think it is, it's rather a "livematch". Nobody is capable of going out in combat because one point could cost the whole match. While I personally think there's more cooperation and better communication on a platform of a TDM, it's not nearly played as much as CTW excluding one hit kill maps... it's not really a significance or skeleton of the network, I would say. Though you may think that holding back is a tactic or rather a map flaw, it ends up in general how the team plays and if some people move forward, the enemy goes forward but they end up going back because they don't want to die.

One of the ideas I had is removing a bow, but it's too much of a component to kill that. The TDM matches in tournaments would just be an arching competition, and too many people hiding back. With DTM, you're forced to actually get the objective and have out positions instead of being a little pack. With this idea presented in OCN however, it didn't change much; it just made people go back.

If you saw in the Wildwood Crevice matches, there wasn't much actual combat. It was all about bowing and using the top, because people are too afraid to venture out. It's just like they stick together like glue, and predicting off our network tournament teams, TDM would play the exact way but poorer.

replies.author: OldSharpie
replies.body: Don't agree with you. TDM are based on strats, even more than CTW or DTC/M. Also, I don't see your problem with archer duels. If a team is loosing by a few points, they will make a final push and that will not be an archer duel.

replies.author: BmB
replies.body:
Yeah you make good points there actually, i think that the real reason i am turning to a TDM as a tiebreaker is that i must say i am not impressed with some of the current tiebreakers entered and personally think a TDM would serve a better purpose than them. 

I think that our best bet is unfortunately something similar to boom as lets be honest most original ideas for a tiebreaker are going to suck. Anything good has already been done.
